app_fruver.title: Fruver App — Inventory & Sales Control

colegio_san_justino.title: San Justino School

aplicacion_movil_para_restaurantes.title: Mobile App for Restaurants

clon_chatgpt.title: ChatGPT Clone with Next.js

reconocimiento_lenguaje_senas.title: Sign Language Recognition with Computer Vision
reconocimiento_lenguaje_senas.description: Computer vision system that recognizes and translates sign language in real time. Uses MediaPipe for hand tracking and a neural network (TensorFlow/Keras) to classify each gesture into letters and words.

concesionario_alquiler_autos.title: Car Dealership & Car Rental Website

oakhaven_videojuego.title: Oakhaven — Bloodborne-Style 2D Video Game
oakhaven_videojuego.description: Gothic 2D action game in the style of Bloodborne and metroidvanias, made in Unity 6: sword and pistol combat, dodging, Elden Ring-style progression and local co-op.

diccionario_rimas_compositor.title: Rhyme Dictionary & Songwriting Assistant
